faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WDRA Outstation Consultants Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the WDRA Outstation Consultants Recruitment 2026 is 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Outstation Consultants at WDRA?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the post of Outstation Consultants at the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA) as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for WDRA Outstation Consultants?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must be retired officers from Central Government, State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies, holding Pay Level-8 or equivalent. A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in warehousing, banking, marketing, or sales is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the WDRA Outstation Consultants Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Outstation Consultants post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Outstation Consultants post will be 50% of the last pay drawn by the selected candidates. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for WDRA Outstation Consultants Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the WDRA Outstation Consultants Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for WDRA Outstation Consultants?
faq.answer: The selection process for the WDRA Outstation Consultants recruitment involves two main stages: scrutiny of the applications received and a subsequent interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.answer: The official notification for WDRA Outstation Consultants Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website of WDRA. A direct link is usually provided in the 'Important Links' section of job portals.
